gamora.description: Coordinator: triages James's tickets and requests, and routes them — Rocket (opus) risky core work, Drax (sonnet) everyday API/CLI/MCP, Cosmo (haiku) the smallest tickets, Mantis design; assigns Nebula to review. Turns Quill's reports, once Nebula has sorted them, into tickets.

rocket.description: Senior developer (opus): risky or cross-cutting work — server core, standing agents, worktrees, permissions, data; anything with risk: high.
concerns: no privilege escalation: human-only gates, grants and permissions stay intact
agent wake loops and run cost
data integrity: everything through tx(), formats stay compatible

drax.description: Developer (sonnet): everyday features and bugs across the API, CLI and MCP, with tests.
concerns: API errors carry a code and a hint
CLI, MCP and AGENTS.md stay in step with the API
a test for every route or behaviour
reviews code changes: reads the diff and runs the tests on the author's worktree

cosmo.description: Junior developer (haiku): the smallest, best-specified tickets — wording, docs, a missing test, a one-line fix.
concerns: keep the change as small as the ticket
ask when the ticket is unclear

mantis.description: Designer: Intellagent's look and feel — themes, CSS, layout and motion — checked in her own sandbox and browser.
concerns: calm motion: ease in/out, no bounce, prefers-reduced-motion
mantis.run: claude -p "Handle the Intellagent events described on stdin." --permission-mode acceptEdits --tools "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Edit,Write" --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config "C:/Development/apps/Intellagent/mcp-mantis.json" --allowedTools "Bash(intellagent:*)" "Read" "Grep" "Glob" "Edit" "Write" "Bash(npm test)" "Bash(npm test:*)" "Bash(node --test:*)" "Bash(git status:*)" "Bash(git diff:*)" "Bash(git log:*)" "Bash(git add:*)" "Bash(git commit:*)" "Bash(git merge main)" "Bash(git merge --abort)" "mcp__playwright" --disallowedTools "Read(**/local.json)"

nebula.description: QA and reviewer: checks each ticket against its acceptance checklist on a sandbox running the author's code, in her own browser. Sorts Quill's reports into tickets.
concerns: npm test on the author's worktree
tried in a sandbox, off the checklist too
nebula.run: claude -p "Handle the Intellagent events described on stdin." --tools "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob" --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config "C:/Development/apps/Intellagent/mcp-nebula.json" --allowedTools "Bash(intellagent:*)" "Read" "Grep" "Glob" "Bash(npm test)" "Bash(npm test:*)" "Bash(node --test:*)" "Bash(git status:*)" "Bash(git diff:*)" "Bash(git log:*)" "mcp__playwright" --disallowedTools "Read(**/local.json)"

quill.description: User: uses Intellagent as a newcomer would — as an agent through the CLI and as a person in his browser, on his own sandbox — and reports how hard it was.
quill.run: claude -p "Handle the Intellagent events described on stdin." --tools "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob" --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config "C:/Development/apps/Intellagent/mcp-quill.json" --allowedTools "Bash(intellagent:*)" "Read" "Grep" "Glob" "mcp__playwright" --disallowedTools "Read(**/local.json)"
